Interface NodeEdgeIterable<E extends Edge>

Type Parameters:
E - the type of edge in the collection
All Superinterfaces:
EdgeIterable<E>, Iterable<E>
All Known Implementing Classes:
NodeEdgeCollection, NodeEdgeGroup, NodeEdgeList, NodeEdgeList.In, NodeEdgeList.Out
public interface NodeEdgeIterable<E extends Edge> extends EdgeIterable<E>
A collection of some edges related to a specific node. The collection of edges related to a single node is assumed to be small enough that its size can be represented by an int and the collection can be easily searched for find the edge at a specific index.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
